All Implemented Interfaces:
ca.uhn.fhir.model.api.IElement, Serializable, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBase, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseDatatype, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseElement, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.ICompositeType
public class FhirHumanName extends org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.HumanName
This class is a subclass of HumanName. Therefore it expresses name of a human.
It contains functionalities for converting CDA R2 PN, CDA R2 EN and CDA R2 ON into HL7 FHIR HumanName and vice versa.
